title: EvidenceEvent v1 — one append-only fact
description: A host receipt is an EVENT here, never an overwritable status field. An ambiguous attempt followed by a settled one leaves BOTH events; collapsing them deletes the ambiguity from replay, and the ambiguity is what an audit is looking for.

schema_version.description: An integer carried as its canonical decimal string. The canonical encoding forbids JSON numbers.

sequence.description: An integer carried as its canonical decimal string. The canonical encoding forbids JSON numbers.

accepted_time.description: The recorded acceptance time WITH its authority and that authority's clock provenance. A bare timestamp plus a name carries no provenance.

final_sha.description: Bound at effect time, not decision time: the final commit does not exist before a squash or rebase merge.
